currency_evidence.evidence: Published monetary PropertyValue records explicitly use unitText USD.

metadata.field_provenance: Each metric/category/source carries source_url and read_at. core_function_source_url/core_function_read_at locate the description; profile_fields_provenance locates other profile details; directory_snapshot preserves original cards. Cached read_at uses file mtime and is explicitly labeled.
revenue_caveats: MRR ≠ past-30-day revenue ≠ all-time revenue ≠ GMV. Neither revenue nor MRR establishes profit. GMV, when displayed instead of Total, is retained separately and revenue_total remains null.
All directory monetary values are public display values; they may be rounded. K/M abbreviations are decoded, not made exact.
Profile metric snapshots preserve the published figure, not full underlying accounting precision.
TrustMRR homepage public Schema.org monetary records explicitly use USD. Dollar displays are retained in that site currency convention; no FX conversion is performed.
Verification is TrustMRR’s provider-API verification claim, not our independent audit.
Founder-supplied product descriptions, categories, pricing and tech stack are not payment-provider-verified.
metadata.costs_and_analysis: All unverified replication costs, inferred web-product status and analysis are null/unknown; no made-up estimates or rankings.
metadata.profile_enrichment_scope: Reused all 393 existing public profile files; additional profile enrichment is bounded by this collection stage, not a cap/filter on the full project export.
metadata.version_scope: Relevant project facts, not request times, pagination order or provider-sync-only changes. Byte checksums are separate.

last_refresh_coverage.note: Dynamic pagination can shift/duplicate/omit records; absent records are retained, not interpreted as closures.

metadata.index_bytes_note: Initial load is the compact index only; full details are fetched in 100-project chunks.
